title: 第九章 怎么都想搞我第十章 内外兼修
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;相国府，后院。
顾颜霜着一袭黑色劲装，长发依旧梳成马尾，负手而立。
明明很男性化的装扮，却掩盖不了那秀丽容颜，和婀娜身段，所散发出的女性魅力，真是又飒又美，英气十足。
顾尘风见之，赞叹道。
“大姐，你今天真是容光焕发，巾帼不让须眉！”
站在院中的顾颜霜，微微一愣，嘴角无意识的翘起，但下一刻就恢复冷厉。
“少给我打岔，你又出城了？”
顾尘风苦笑，话题转移失败。
他只得讪讪点头。
“诶……出去了一趟，不过我带了护卫，近期也不会再离开帝都了。”
看着顾尘风老实认怂的样子，顾颜霜刚到嘴边的训斥，又收了回来。
“罢了，先不说此事。
那日在太荒岭刺杀你的杀手，经过尸检，已确认，他们并非帝都人士。
且身上被种过蛊虫，应该是北疆武者的手段。
但北疆与我大离王朝素无来往，且距离遥远，不可能为帝都各方势力所驱使。”
“蛊虫，北疆。”
顾尘风心中微凛。
衍州大地，疆域辽阔，王朝众多，东西南北各有一方霸主。
分别是大炎，大周，大离，大夏。

大离王朝是衍州南部的霸主。
所谓的北疆，就是衍州北部，大夏王朝统治的一带。
大夏王朝与大离王朝，相距甚远，中间隔着一片茫茫冰原。
曾经称霸南部的蛮族，就生活在这片冰原。
“如此说来，那两人不是帝都敌对势力，派来杀我的？”
今日珍禽园一行，顾尘风基本可以肯定。
自己意外坠崖之事，和张邮脱不了干系。
但他也有个疑惑。
按理说，自己坠崖后，若无冷星夜出手，早已死无葬身之地。
张邮为何还要派人，在悬崖下追杀自己。
岂不是多此一举，反而会留下痕迹。
如今终于得到了答案。
原来那两名杀手，是另一伙人派来的。
顾尘风心中顿感郁闷。
“靠，怎么这么多人要搞我？”
顾颜霜安慰道：“虽然不知道，这些人出于何种目的，对你下手，但他们已经失败。
如今行迹败露，自不敢再轻易出手，而我也派人在调查此事，很快会有结果。”
随后，顾颜霜话锋一转。

read2(); Prime Minister’s Mansion, backyard.
Gu Yanshuang was wearing a black outfit, her long hair was still combed into a ponytail, and she stood with her hands behind her back.
The dress is obviously very masculine, but it can't hide the beautiful face and graceful figure. The feminine charm exudes is really sassy, ​​beautiful and full of heroic spirit.
Gu Chenfeng saw it and admired it.
"Sister, you are so radiant today, you are like a woman!"
Gu Yanshuang, who was standing in the courtyard, was slightly startled, the corners of her mouth raised unconsciously, but she returned to being cold and stern the next moment.
"Don't interrupt me. Are you out of town again?"
Gu Chenfeng smiled bitterly, but failed to change the topic.
He could only nod.
"Hey...I went out for a trip, but I brought a guard with me, and I won't leave the imperial capital again in the near future."
Seeing how Gu Chenfeng was giving in, Gu Yanshuang took back the scolding she had just begun to say.
"That's all, let's not talk about it for now.
The autopsy of the assassins who assassinated you in Taihuang Ridge that day has confirmed that they were not from the imperial capital.
Moreover, the body has been planted with Gu insects, which should be the method of warriors from Northern Xinjiang.
However, Northern Xinjiang has no contact with our Dali Dynasty, and the distance is far away, so it is impossible to be driven by all forces in the imperial capital. "
"Gu worm, Northern Border."
Gu Chenfeng felt a little chilled in his heart.
The land of Yanzhou has a vast territory and many dynasties. Each has its own overlord in the east, west, north and south.
They are Dayan, Dazhou, Dali and Daxia.
The Dali Dynasty was the overlord of southern Yanzhou.
The so-called Northern Xinjiang refers to the northern part of Yanzhou, the area ruled by the Daxia Dynasty.
The Daxia Dynasty and the Dali Dynasty were far apart, separated by a vast ice field.
The barbarians who once dominated the south lived in this ice field.
"So, those two people were not hostile forces in the imperial capital, sent to kill me?"
Gu Chenfeng was basically certain about the group in the rare bird garden today.
Zhang You's accidental fall from the cliff has nothing to do with it.
But he also had a doubt.
It stands to reason that after falling off the cliff, if Leng Xingye had not taken action, he would have died long ago without a burial place.
Why did Zhang You send people to chase him under the cliff?
Isn't it unnecessary and will leave traces instead?
Now I finally got the answer.
It turned out that the two killers were sent by another group of people.
Gu Chenfeng suddenly felt depressed.
"Damn, why are so many people trying to mess with me?"
Gu Yanshuang consoled her, "Although I don't know what purpose these people had in attacking you, they have failed.
Now that his whereabouts have been exposed, I dare not take action easily again, and I have also sent people to investigate the matter, and the results will be available soon. "
Then, Gu Yanshuang changed the topic.
